html: A new page, Check a file, checks one v0.2 record or an entity-graph bundle in the browser and explains each failure: the field, the rule and what the specification says. It runs the repository's own tools/validate.py and tools/check_entity_graph.py, unchanged, in Python compiled to WebAssembly, so its verdicts are the reference validator's; a test runs all 147 example files through both and fails on any difference. The file is not uploaded or sent anywhere: the page fetches only its own files from this site, makes no request while it checks, and has no visit counter. The home page links to it from the door for software builders. A pass means structurally conformant at Level 1. The page says that Level 2 and Level 3 are not checked.
